models_evaluated: 19 LLM judges (unnamed in text), including general-purpose and safety-specialized guard models

links.outcome: Agreement of automated LLM judges with clinician ratings on safety, accuracy and communication quality
links.effect: Spearman ρ > 0.80 for safety screening and factual verification; ρ < 0.60 for communication quality; safety-specialized guard models underperformed general-purpose models.
links.quote: LLM judges achieved strong clinician agreement for safety screening and factual verification (Spearman  ρ > 0.80) but weaker agreement for communication quality (  ρ < 0.60).

links.outcome: Interrater reliability of clinician reference ratings across seven rubric criteria
links.effect: Clinician reference ratings showed strong interrater reliability across all criteria.
links.quote: Clinician reference ratings showed strong interrater reliability across all criteria.
